description: The ten features of the station's learning model as they are computed today, without the turntable profile as zero point. Weights of different signal chains are therefore only partly comparable; feature version 2 will express the features relative to the profile. The fixed scaling below never changes within this feature version: contributions do not carry it, so a changed scaling is a new feature version. Binary features are centred on their most common value (gc_missing on 1, as most stations have no second opinion), so that a constant feature does not shift the intercept.
coefficients: coef[0] is the intercept; coef[i + 1] belongs to features[i]. The model is p = 1 / (1 + exp(-(coef[0] + sum(coef[i + 1] * (x[i] - center[i]) / scale[i]))))

features.name: log_strength
features.definition: ln(1 + max(strength, 0)); strength = detector peak / local standard deviation of the residual

features.name: amp_rel
features.definition: event level in dBFS (-60 if unknown) minus the music reference level of the recording (-15 dBFS if unknown)

features.name: gc_missing
features.definition: 1 if the second-opinion score is missing, else 0

features.name: music
features.definition: 1 if the event lies in the music region of the side, else 0

features.name: both_ch
features.definition: 1 if the event was detected on both channels, else 0

features.name: log_density
features.definition: ln(1 + number of other events of the recording within +-0.5 s)
